issues.description: Conflicting conventions about which registers must be preserved when implementing set_pixel / calculating the pixel address. The problem statement (Teil b) explicitly requires that no registers except EAX may be modified by set_pixel (i.e. EBX, ECX, ESI, etc. must be preserved). The template's inline comment in main near the position-calculation TODO says to save registers you modify "except eax,ebx and esi" (implying EBX and ESI need not be saved). This discrepancy between the problem text and the template comment can confuse students about the required calling/side-effect convention. The provided solution follows the problem statement (preserving registers other than EAX).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the register-preservation convention consistent: update the template comment to match the problem statement (explicitly state that only EAX may be clobbered and all other registers must be preserved), or modify the problem description to match the template if the intent was different. Also add a short calling-convention note in the template near set_pixel (which registers contain x, y, color and which registers may be clobbered).
